newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Gulf to issue prfrd shares.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Gulf to issue prfrd shares.

text.p: Pacific Gulf Properties Inc said on Wednesday that it has agreed to issue 1,411,765 shares of class B senior cumulative convertible preferred stock to Five Arrows Realty Securities LLC for $21.25 a share.
Each share of the preferred stock is convertible into one share of Pacific Gulf common stock, it said. Net proceeds are expected to be $28.2 million, Pacific Gulf said.
Under the terms of the agreement, the company may issue the class B preferred shares in up to three separate closings of at least $5 million, on or prior to December 31, 1997.
In a separate statement, Pacific Gulf Properties said it has begun a public equity offering of 1,500,000 shares of common stock.
Net proceeds from the common stock offering will be used to to fund acquisitions, to repay certain indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.
The common stock offering will be sole-managed by Prudential Securities Inc, Pacific Gulf said.

The annual dividend per share on the class B preferred is $1.70 from the date of issuance until December 31, 1997 and the greater of $1.70 or 104% of the then-current common stock dividend after 1997.
